title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for many years of reliable partnership. We want a solution that keeps your foundry healthy and our prices stable.

Index idx:PPI-D351@2025-11 at 140.5 fell to idx:PPI-D351@2026-04 at 123.7, a change of -11.96 %.
Our should-cost cost:310010 estimates your plant's unit cost at EUR 132.64.
Our current contract ctr:4600070110 runs to 31 December 2026, so a new price should start no earlier than 2027.

We attach three packages for 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. You will find different payment terms among them, since you asked for faster payment. Could you also tell us about cheaper casting variants and your earliest lead time?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. For our calculation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.

We respect the terms of our current contract and agree to adjust the effective date to 1 January 2027. Our Angebot stands at a price of €138.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €135.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings: revised packages for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for moving the start date and for checking our figures. We remember your support in 2022 and want a fair, stable price for both sides.

Index idx:PPI-D351@2025-08 at 137.0 fell to idx:PPI-D351@2026-08 at 131.9, a change of -3.72 %.
Scorecard sc:70110@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 85.2 % (amber).

As your index spreadsheet was last updated two years ago, a fresh review may show lower costs. Our packages cover 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. Because you asked for faster payment, one package offers 14-day terms. Could you tell us what faster payment is worth to you, and whether a cheaper casting variant is possible?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings: revised packages for 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have reviewed the delivery scorecard data you provided; we take our performance seriously and have adjusted our calculation accordingly. However, the index data you cited reflects trends we had already incorporated into our previous offer.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. In response to your inquiry about faster payment, we can offer a price of €133.50 per unit for 14-day payment terms starting 1 April 2027. To summarize our offer clearly, we propose a price of €133.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value our longstanding relationship between our businesses deeply and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
